title: Unintentionally, Acting Like Everything Is Fine

scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Seung-chan spotting two cartons of milk outside Joon-mo's flat, pitching Cindy for the variety team, and arriving with sweet pancakes.

scenes.title: Hangover Pancakes and Drunken Scolding
scenes.summary: Heavily drunk, Seung-chan delivers sweet pancakes to Ye-jin, calls her a liar in casual speech, passes out in Joon-mo's living room, and scolds Joon-mo for two-timing.

scenes.title: Temporary Address-Sharing Relationship
scenes.summary: Over morning pancakes, Seung-chan politely reveals he lives in the building opposite, prompting Joon-mo and Ye-jin to insist they are merely childhood friends temporarily sharing an address.

scenes.title: Probation Strikes and a Family Clinic
scenes.summary: Outside the apartment complex, Jum-soon catches Seung-chan coming from a neighbor's building and asks him to book his brother-in-law on a health show while Seung-chan worries about probation.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Agency Offer
scenes.summary: Il-yong suggests holding an audition competition for their vacant cast slot just before an entertainment agency head calls Joon-mo to offer himself as the new cast member.

scenes.title: Cindy Chooses Variety
scenes.summary: Cindy shocks CEO Byun by insisting on joining Joon-mo's outdoor variety show to win broader public affection, reminding Byun of ten years of obedience and claiming she is easygoing.
scenes.location: CEO Byun's office and Cindy's van

scenes.title: Fried Dumplings and Keeping Secrets
scenes.summary: Ye-jin buys Seung-chan lunch with fried dumplings to make sure he never leaks her living arrangement, then deducts fifty thousand won from her car-repair debt for his overnight stay.

scenes.title: No More Dating Producers
scenes.summary: Seung-chan is relieved to learn Joon-mo and Hye-joo broke up, until Ye-jin adds that Hye-joo swore never to date another producer and spots Seung-chan's crush right away.

scenes.title: The Power of a Producer's Grudge
scenes.summary: Summoned by regulators over Cindy's stage outfit, Ye-jin tells Cindy's manager that Cindy can sit out Music Bank for the week and lectures her staff on remembering every favor and slight.
scenes.location: Music Bank meeting room at KBS

scenes.title: Ankle-Deep Water and Braised Dishes
scenes.summary: CEO Byun demands strict contract terms banning water dunking and soup for Cindy, leaving Tae-ho and Joon-mo to negotiate compromises down to ankle-deep water and braised side dishes.

scenes.title: How Did You Cast Cindy
scenes.summary: Ji-yeon and Il-yong marvel that Cindy agreed to join the show and tease Seung-chan that the top star must have been charmed by the rookie producer's handsome face.

scenes.title: Just Show Who You Really Are
scenes.summary: In a quiet KBS stairwell, Cindy tells Seung-chan she joined the program because of him and asks him to stay strictly on her side, while he advises her simply to be herself.

scenes.title: Waiting for Calls and Blind-Date News
scenes.summary: Ye-jin waits anxiously for Cindy's agency to call, listens irritably as Joon-mo accepts a blind date with a prosecutor, and urges Seung-chan to confess his feelings to Hye-joo.
scenes.location: KBS lobby and Yeouido parking lot

scenes.title: A Sprained Wrist and Unspoken Worry
scenes.summary: Seung-chan helps carry bags for Ye-jin's sprained wrist, leading Joon-mo to scold her for clumsiness and letting men inside while quietly reminding her not to skip breakfast.

scenes.title: Packing for the Variety Battlefield
scenes.summary: After late-night game simulations, Ji-yeon strips Seung-chan's rookie backpack down to candy, cup noodles, instant coffee, and fish sauce, and Seung-chan tells Ye-jin he envies Joon-mo.
scenes.location: KBS variety office and convenience store

scenes.title: Secret Dawn Prank and Angel Nicknames
scenes.summary: Cindy's manager agrees to keep the dawn wake-up camera secret while Cindy brainstorms warm variety nicknames, and Il-yong coaches Seung-chan on serving fish-sauce iced coffee.
scenes.location: KBS cafe, Cindy's van, and hallway

scenes.title: No Iced Coffee in the Morning
scenes.summary: Woken at dawn without makeup, Cindy politely refuses the rigged iced coffee, agonizes over casual shoes in her van, and smells leaking fish sauce from Seung-chan's backpack.

scenes.title: Couple Selection at the Starting Line
scenes.summary: Cindy greets the older female guests with sweet politeness before Joon-mo announces the couple-selection game, warning that anyone unchosen will travel to a remote camp with the rookie producer.

scenes.title: Zero Votes and Polite Humiliation
scenes.summary: Left behind with zero votes while CEO Byun fumes back in Seoul, Cindy vows to charm rookie Seung-chan on camera, only to learn he knows neither her songs nor her dramas.

scenes.title: CEO Byun Storms the Filming Site
scenes.summary: CEO Byun barges onto Joon-mo's filming location, grills the male guests over why nobody picked Cindy, and demands that Joon-mo throw out the footage and hold a revote.

scenes.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors on the Mountain Trail
scenes.summary: Hiking three kilometers uphill, Cindy suggests rock-paper-scissors to carry each other's bags, loses to deadpan Seung-chan, insists on honoring the bet, and notices his untied shoelace.

scenes.title: Twenty Years as Just Friends
scenes.summary: After soothing Joon-mo's suspicious mother at a cafe, Ye-jin bickers over ramen with her brother Ye-joon, who points out that no man keeps a woman beside him for twenty years without feelings.
scenes.location: KBS hallway, cafe, and Joon-mo's apartment

scenes.title: Stranded After Dark
scenes.summary: Lost on the darkening mountain trail with poor phone reception and no dinner, Cindy panics at Seung-chan and refuses to let him carry her bag lest viewers criticize her.

scenes.title: Epilogue and closing credits
scenes.summary: Epilogue flashback to Cindy noticing Seung-chan in the rain and closing credits.
